Chapter 425 - 425 Gaming Helmet (1)

Chapter 425 - 425 Gaming Helmet (1)

425 Gaming Helmet (1)

Lu Ling looked at Lin Fan’s awkward expression and rolled her eyes. She deliberately said in a pitiful tone, “I was the first one to send you an email.”

Then, she could not help but burst out laughing. “I lied to you. I didn’t send you an email.”

After a pause, Lu Ling said, “Oh right, what books are you looking for in the library this time?”

Lin Fan coughed lightly and said, “Nervous System Research, From Neuron to Brain, The Constitution of Neuron, Nervous Transmission, Animation, Mathematical Methods in 3D Games and Computer Images, and Game Program Patterns. Reward: Computer science experience increases by one level, gaming helmet, and working principles.”

“Nervous Transmission, Animation, Game Program Patterns? What do you want to study?” Lu Ling was a little puzzled. “A sensory game?”

She had done some research on these things and quickly made a guess.

“You can say that,” said Lin Fan.

Lu Ling’s interest was immediately piqued. Her eyes turned into crescents as she said happily, “That’s great! I hope you can invent it as soon as possible!”

Obviously, she was very interested in games.

Lin Fan said, “Don’t worry, it won’t take long.”

The two of them walked forward as they talked.

They passed through the language section, the mathematics section, the chemistry section…

They went to the medical neurology category and found Nervous System Research, From Neuron to Brain, The Constitution of Neuron, and Nervous Transmission.

Then, the two went to the animation and game programming bookshelf and found Animation, Mathematical Methods in 3D Games and Computer Images, and Game Program Patterns.

After that, they each carried a few thick books and sat down in their usual seats.

Lin Fan did not hesitate too much. He opened a book and flipped through it quickly.

In just two minutes, he had finished flipping through the hundreds of pages of the book.

This scene…

Liu Qianqian, who was walking into the library, saw everything. She had wanted to ask Lin Fan to give her some guidance.

However, she quickly shut her mouth and revealed a thoughtful look.

…

After more than 20 minutes, Lin Fan finished reading the last book—Game Program Patterns.

Lin Fan had just put down his book when a crisp voice rang out in his mind.

[Ding! Congratulations on completing the mission. Watch a biology experiment (1/1) and a computer experiment (1/1). Read Nervous System Research, From Neuron to Brain, The Constitution of Neuron, Nervous Transmission, Animation, Mathematical Methods in 3D Games and Computer Images, and Game Program Patterns. Reward: Computer and biology experience increases by one level, gaming helmet, and working principles.]

[Ding! Upgrade successful! Congratulations, you’ve obtained Academician Computer Experience!]

[Ding! Upgrade successful! Congratulations, you’ve obtained Academician Biology Experience!]

…

*#*#1472365#*#*

*#*#64663#*#*

…

C02+H20—-(CH20)+O2

6CO2+12H20—-C6H1206+6H2O+6O2

…

Instantly, a huge amount of codes and complicated biological knowledge flooded Lin Fan’s mind like a tidal wave.

Then, the principle of creating the gaming helmet appeared in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Do you wish to extract the gaming helmet?]

Mission accomplished!

He could use the gaming helmet immediately!

Even Lin Fan could not help but feel excited.

He stood up and said, “I have something to do, so I’ll leave first.”

After saying that, he strode out.

He could not wait to retrieve the gaming helmet and play with it.

Lu Ling opened her mouth and was about to say something.

However, looking at how anxious Lin Fan was, he could only swallow his words.

She looked at the draft paper on the table and muttered, “Anyway… This time, there’s only one question that I can’t answer. I’ll save it for next time.”

…

Lin Fan did not choose to go to the office. Instead, he drove the Cullinan back to the Coiling Dragon Villa.

[Do you wish to extract the gaming helmet?]

“Yes!”

In the next moment, a helmet made of metal appeared in front of him.

This… was the gaming helmet!

Lin Fan looked at the helmet curiously.

Then, he put it on his head.

The gaming helmet was made of metal on the outside, but the inside was very soft and comfortable. It also had excellent soundproofing properties.

Lin Fan placed the carbon-based chip into a backup phone.

Then, he upgraded the phone’s program on the computer.

About half an hour later, everything was ready.

Lin Fan muttered, “I have the equipment. Now, I need to design a game.”

Thinking of this…

Lin Fan could not help but feel a headache.

Even though he had Academician Computer Experience and mastered the production and working principles of the gaming helmet, it was extremely troublesome for him to design a game by himself.

Without a few days or even dozens of days of hard work, it would probably be impossible to complete.

Lin Fan sighed and said, “Forget it. I’ll apply for a patent and publish a thesis first.”

Even though Lin Fan had endless wealth, he was not sloppy when it came to applying for patents for inventions.

Otherwise, when his inventions were circulated to the market, the patents would be registered by others.

That would put him in an extremely passive position.

As for publishing a thesis…

It was almost a habit of Lin Fan’s.
